value.rationale: The source discovers local bistability but does not resolve which initial opinions select which long-run outcome in the strict subcritical wedge. This theorem supplies a natural complete global classification on the whole simplex, a finite-step full-turnout guarantee, an exact critical vote-difference threshold, finite-time alternating unanimity above it, a logarithmic decision-time divergence and an exact radical benchmark. This is a structural basin and transition theorem, not merely a reparameterization or computed example. The fixed-composition turnout reversal makes the qualitative basin distinction concrete without changing model parameters.
